title: US Disrupts North Korean FaceStealer Crypto Theft Campaign
excerpt: The United States government has taken action against a North Korean social engineering campaign known as FaceStealer.
body_html:
The United States government has successfully disrupted a North Korean social engineering operation named FaceStealer. According to reports, this malicious campaign has been linked to the theft of more than $400 million in cryptocurrency.

Authorities intervened to halt the activities associated with the campaign, which targeted digital assets through social engineering tactics.
